explanation.headline: Esmolol hydrochloride is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Corvale East has 19.9 days on hand and Corvale General has 27.8 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's records show esmolol hydrochloride is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 214 vials of the 100 mg/10 mL presentation with 10.7 vials used per day, providing 19.9 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 386 vials of the same presentation with 13.9 vials used per day, providing 27.8 days on hand.
The product label identifies Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC as the labeler and plant (FEI 3014288534) with a VAI inspection classification dated 2024-09-11.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.
Alternate manufacturers Baxter Healthcare Company and Baxter Healthcare Corporation are also not on FDA's shortage list today, but their labels name no plant we could place.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
